synopsis: A man discovers a lemon that has the elasticity and bounce of a rubber ball, defying its natural fruit properties.
narration: This lemon has been on my counter for days. It always feels different. Today, it completely bounced off the floor! I seriously can't believe it.

shots.prompt: A bright yellow, medium-sized oval lemon with a slightly dimpled, waxy skin and one small dark stem scar visible at one end, feeling remarkably elastic and bouncy. The lemon's skin and flesh possess the extreme elasticity and resilience of high-grade rubber, causing it to deform under pressure but instantly spring back to its original shape and bounce vigorously. A close-up view of the lemon on a dark speckled stone-look counter, with hands entering from the sides. A lived-in home kitchen counter: dark speckled stone-look surface with faint scratches and a few crumbs near the edge, a tiled backsplash behind, and morning daylight from a side window mixing with a warm under-cabinet glow. A pair of hands wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt gently squeeze a bright yellow lemon, which visibly deforms under the pressure but instantly regains its perfect oval shape. The view stays in one unchanging position and angle for the whole shot.
shots.violation_observation: The lemon deforms significantly under gentle finger pressure but immediately snaps back to its perfect spherical shape.
